title: Two Hamzahs in One Word - ءَامَنتُمْ in Surah al-Aʿrāf
titleEn: Two Hamzahs in One Word - ءَامَنتُمْ in Surah al-Aʿrāf
description: The word ءَامَنتُمْ in Surah al-Aʿrāf is paired with an additional أَ for Imams Nafi', Abu 'Amr, Ibn Kathir, Ibn 'Amir, Hamzah, Kisai and Shu'bah. Thus while for the Imam Hafs the rules of two hamzahs don't apply here as for him there is only 1 hamzah in this word, for the remaining qurra they do.

tashil_of_second.title: Tashῑl of 2nd
tashil_of_second.description: These qurra will pair an extra hamzah to the start of this word which will be read with tahqiq and the 2nd hamzah with tashῑl.

ibdal_of_first_and_tashil.title: Ibdal of the first into a waw and tashῑl of 2nd
ibdal_of_first_and_tashil.description: Imam Qunbul will make ibdaal of the first hamzahinto a waw and tashῑl of the second: وَأَمِنتُمْ
ibdal_of_first_and_tashil.note: The ibdaal of the first hamzah into a waw is in wasl only, while a reader would typically not be be starting recitation from this word, theoretically if they were the first hamzah would be read with tahqiq (the same as is read by Imam Nafi' and those that join him from this word).

tahqiq_of_both.title: Taḥqīq of both
tahqiq_of_both.description: Both hamzahs will be read clearly (taḥqīq) with no changes made to either - ءَأَٰمَنتُمْ
